name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

domain_gates.subject: landholding_hectares
domain_gates.description: Eligible families must hold cultivable land of up to 2 hectares (approximately 5 acres) as recorded in the land record of the State/UT.

soft_clauses.text: Institutional landholders, trust and charitable organisations, and landholdings held under community/collective cultivation rights are excluded from the benefit.
Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Departments, PSUs and autonomous bodies (except Class IV and multi-tasking staff) are excluded.
Income-tax payers in the assessment year preceding the current year are excluded from the benefit.
Registration is accepted continuously through the portal or a Common Service Centre; there is no fixed annual application deadline, so the intake window has no closing date.
soft_clauses.source: Portal behaviour observed at verification time

benefits.description: Fixed income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred directly into the bank account of small and marginal farmer families.
benefits.eligibility_note: Paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 (Apr–Jul, Aug–Nov, Dec–Mar). Credit is conditional on Aadhaar authentication and active DBT seeding.

benefits_summary: ₹6,000 per year paid directly to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account in three instalments of ₹2,000 — unconditional DBT income support.
eligibility_text: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi provides income support of ₹6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families holding cultivable land of up to 2 hectares, credited by direct benefit transfer in three instalments of ₹2,000. Open to eligible land-holding farmer families across all States and Union Territories of India with no upper age limit. The bank account must be seeded with Aadhaar and enabled for DBT; Aadhaar authentication is required. Institutional landholders, income-tax payers in the previous assessment year, and serving or retired officers of Central and State Governments, PSUs and autonomous bodies are excluded. Registration can be completed online or at a Common Service Centre and is accepted continuously through the year.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.notes: Mandatory for Aadhaar authentication at registration and at each instalment release.

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook with Aadhaar Seeding (DBT enabled)
required_documents.notes: The DBT credit fails if the account is not Aadhaar-seeded; this is the single most common disbursement failure.

required_documents.name: Land Record / ROR / Khasra Extract
required_documents.issuance_authority: State Revenue Department / Tehsildar / District Land Records Office
required_documents.notes: Highest-friction document in this scheme (Tier 4): requires a visit to the Tehsil or a State land-records portal. Must show the family's cultivable holding for the 2-hectare domain gate.

required_documents.name: Farmer Self-Declaration on Non-Exclusion
required_documents.notes: Tier 0 — attests that the applicant is not an institutional landholder, income-tax payer or excluded government employee.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Demographic Authentication Consent
required_documents.notes: Tier 0 — consent form for offline Aadhaar (DBI) authentication.

required_documents.name: CSC Registration Receipt
required_documents.notes: Recommended only when registering through a CSC; weight 0.0 so it never penalises an online registrant.

intake_window.source_note: Continuous intake observed on the PM-Kisan portal: new registrations are accepted year-round with no published closing date; instalment cycles are quarterly.
